text: {"name":"dma_rx_enqueue_packet","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Enqueues an RX packet as one or more buffer segments, advancing to linked buffers when the packet exceeds the current buffer.","subsystem":"dma","var_renames":{"a1":"current_buffer_ptr","a2":"remaining_length","a3":"buffer_offset_ptr","v3":"rx_packet_state","v4":"current_buffer","v5":"buffer_offset","v7":"ring_write_index_ptr","v9":"packet_bytes_enqueued","v10":"length_after_buffer","v11":"ring_slot_index","v13":"ring_entry","v18":"next_buffer","v25":"ring_entries","v26":"previous_buffer"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":4,"meaning":"RX buffer descriptor's next-buffer pointer"},{"offset":8,"meaning":"RX buffer's current data offset, also stored in the ring entry"},{"offset":12,"meaning":"RX buffer's last valid data index"},{"offset":0,"meaning":"Ring entry segment length"},{"offset":3,"meaning":"Ring entry flags; bit 2 marks the final segment"},{"offset":4,"meaning":"Ring entry's RX buffer data offset"},{"offset":2,"meaning":"RX packet state completion indicator"},{"offset":3,"meaning":"RX packet state segment counter"},{"offset":8,"meaning":"RX packet state pointer to the current ring entry"}]}
